usageNotes: Sends a hard reset signal to a running QEMU VM — equivalent to pressing the physical reset button — bypassing a clean shutdown and risking filesystem corruption or data loss on the guest. Use only when the VM is unresponsive and a graceful reboot via the guest OS or QEMU agent is not possible. Returns a task UPID string; poll the node task log to confirm completion.

examples.summary: Force-reset a frozen VM (VMID 105) on node pve1

destructiveReason: Issues an immediate hard reset to the VM without flushing guest disk buffers, which can corrupt filesystems or lose in-flight writes on the guest.
tips: Prefer sending a reboot command via the QEMU guest agent (post_nodes_node_qemu_vmid_agent) before resorting to a hard reset.
The skiplock parameter is root-only; do not pass it from API tokens unless running as root.
The returned UPID can be queried with get_nodes_node_tasks_upid_status to confirm the reset completed.
